help.out:
ugh — semantic operation-ideal version control

  the daily spine (a selection — symbol / glob / NL / feature / set — is the argument):
  ugh save [-m "<msg>"] [--as "<feature>"]   record your edits + show which feature they landed in
  ugh now [--json]            where am I, what next — in flight / needs you / recently done
  ugh log [--json]            the feature map: one lane per feature, edits over time —
                              --rail (saves, newest first) · --tree (feature tree) ·
                              --summary (what needs attention) · --refresh (reflect new edits)
  ugh show <sel>              what is this? — any id ugh printed: what it covers, what
                              would go with it, and what you can do next
  ugh undo                    invert the last mutating operation (the unified op log)
  ugh revert <sel>            remove a selection and everything built on it
  ugh restore <sel>           bring a selection back, along with what it needs
  ugh resolve <symbol>        guided fork resolution when two versions of one symbol compete

  navigation + inspection:
  ugh switch <branch>         move HEAD to a branch's committed tree (mines both ends)
  ugh diff <ref_a> <ref_b>    semantic diff: the symmetric difference of two ideals
  ugh intent <cmd>            per-feature checkpoints (intent segments): list/show/build;
                              rewind one with `ugh revert <feature>@<n>`

  agentic loop:
  ugh plan <cmd>              intake/abandon/status a stated plan's predicted hollow ops
  ugh save --resolve-plan     settle an ambiguous plan-step match a save couldn't auto-confirm

  groupings:
  ugh feature <cmd>           author/re-cut features: regroup (merge/split/move),
                              rename, select   (`why` is the top-level `ugh why <sel>`)
  ugh advanced <cmd>          maintenance/rare verbs: blame, edit, fulfill, commit, fsck,
                              resync (recover after a git history rewrite), ops, state,
                              oracle, after, fold, preview, tiers, identity, migrate,
                              history, compose, forks, review-queue, unstage, repair,
                              merge-op, split-op, transplant

  collaboration + setup:
  ugh sync [remote] [branch]  fetch + merge a teammate's work; union ops, reconcile, fork
  ugh land <branch> [--json]  advance a shared branch record by CAS, gated oracle-green
  ugh push [remote] [branch]  non-forcing git push; a rejection routes you to `ugh sync`
  ugh propose <cmd>           a base+Δ review object: create/status/land/render/publish
  ugh session <cmd>           named scratch-tree lifecycle: start/status/land/gc
  ugh init [path] [--horizon <ref>]   bind git + the kernel op store; mine existing history
  ugh mcp [path]              run the MCP stdio server for coding-agent clients
  ugh git <args...>           pass through to real git (refuses tree-mutating verbs)

  <sel> resolves an op-id / prefix, a `file::name` symbol, a glob, a feature id/label, or
  an NL phrase; read verbs take --json for the machine-readable ugh.api projection.
